description:
Stabilization Phase 3, part 2 of 2: the wall-clock-anchored offset
estimate (method A) and the frame-to-IMU mapping with clamp
bookkeeping (deliverables 2-5).

- Method A, estimateOffsetFromAnchors: each MCRAW frame's per-frame
  JSON carries recvdTimestampMs (epoch ms, the app-side receive
  time of that frame; the same key telemetry-parser exposes as the
  CaptureTimestamp tag - established MotionCam wall anchor, not an
  ritiMCRAW invention), and the GCSV header timestamp key carries
  the log-start epoch ms. Two wall timestamps over one shared epoch
  give the bridge:
    offsetNs = (frame0RecvdMs - gcsvLogStartMs)*1e6 - frame0CaptureNs
  since the first gyro sample IS the log start (t=0). Documented
  error budget in Sync.h: header ms + recvd ms quantization
  (+/-0.5 ms each) + the unobservable first-frame receive lag
  (within-clip receive jitter measured at -13.2..+3.5 ms and
